top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 achievement is mature and unbroken, from proglucagon processing and the insulinotropic action of GLP-1 to long-acting agonists, confirmed by large independent randomized trials in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. I credit physiology plus therapy: Drucker and Holst for the physiology, and Knudsen for converting a peptide with a half-life of minutes into a once-weekly medicine, which tested the physiology in patients. Her contribution is documented and undisputed, whereas the Mojsov priority record cannot be verified from the supplied materials. P002 is a close second and I would accept it; no award is clearly worse.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to any GLP-1 laureate named in the slate (co-authorship of the 2016 spatial transcriptomics paper is unrelated)
